items.name: Maxwell Montes (Venus)
items.stat: 11 km high, capped in metallic 'snow' of lead frost

items.name: Boösaule Montes (Io)
items.stat: 18 km tall, tilting on Jupiter's volcanic hell-moon

items.name: Olympus Mons (Mars)
items.stat: 22 km high, wider than the whole of France

items.name: Equatorial Ridge (Iapetus)
items.stat: 20 km wall wrapping a moon like a walnut seam

items.name: Rheasilvia Central Peak (Vesta)
items.stat: 22 km peak on an asteroid, rivaling Mars' giant
